signature.title: Signature Moment
signature.lead: A true story from one of Indonesia's toughest oversight missions.
signature.body: When OSS 2.0 was being built, 15.4 million+ existing business identification numbers could not stop for a single second. Our team stood as the independent guardian: layered methodology oversight, service continuity through transition and cutover, and validation of the KBLI 2020 → 2025 migration.
highlights: Oversight of 5 core OSS modules: Basic Requirements, Business Licensing & PB UMKU, Information Services, System Management
Service continuity — the existing OSS stayed stable without disruption during cutover
Validation of the KBLI 2020 → 2025 update and migration of 15.4M+ historical business IDs

about.title: About Us
about.body: PT Cartenz Technology Indonesia was founded in 2014 with the spirit of "Turning Vision into Action". Cakrawala is our IT consulting service team for central government institutions — continuing a track record as a pioneer of integrated digital public services for local tax and online transaction monitoring.
